title: Squadrons
tagline: The agent harness for DeFi — named scouts, onchain search, and capped live loops.
description:
Squadrons is the agent harness for DeFi. Instead of a generic chatbot with tools bolted on, you get a desk of named crypto agents — each with a home chain, memory, and an activity trail — that you can research with, Arm into strategies, and graduate from Observe → Paper → Live without babysitting every tick.

Coding harnesses are built for repos (web search, docs, terminals, PRs). DeFi needs different primitives. Squadrons replaces those with onchain search (subgraphs / pools / TVL), Crypto Twitter pulse, DEX quotes and backtests, and armed strategy loops that run as deterministic host recipes — not LLM-on-every-tick. Spend is fail-closed: per-agent caps (default $10 auto-trade ceiling), Tenderly simulation where configured, and Live only when the operator and host both allow it.

Operators pick a chain (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Unichain, World Chain, Robinhood, Arc Testnet), create an agent, research with skills and MCP plugins, draft a strategy in chat, Arm it, paper-trade against live quotes, then go live under gas / slippage / spend guardrails. Optional self-improvement proposes param patches for desk approval.

Custody is one Privy embedded wallet per user, shared across agents. Fund with Privy Add funds (fiat or crypto → USDC). Live settlement broadcasts through Privy’s Wallet API after a one-time session-signer grant — keys never sit in Squadrons. On Arc, agents trade USDC↔EURC via Circle Swap Kit through that same Privy path. The Graph powers Chain Search (Subgraph MCP) and Event Pipeline (NL → Substreams package → token-flow strategies), including Robinhood-focused top-token flows where traditional indexers are weak.
how_its_made:
Squadrons is a pnpm monorepo: Next.js desk (apps/web) + Node 22 host supervisor (apps/host) + shared types/policy/recipes (packages/shared) + Cordis/dsh plugins (packages/squadrons-*).

Web: Privy React for email/wallet login, embedded EVM wallets on login, Add funds (useAddFunds), and session-signer grant (useSigners). The desk is a three-column My Agents UI with SSE streaming for mid-turn tool activity and GenUI cards (Chain Search, Substreams pipelines, backtests).

Host: verifies Privy access tokens, scopes agents by Privy DID, injects the shared wallet into agent turns, and runs long-lived dsh harnesses. Chat can draft strategies; Arm starts a deterministic recipe loop on the host scheduler. Observe/Paper never broadcast. Live builds swaps via 0x on ETH L2s or Circle Swap Kit on Arc Testnet, then signs through Privy Wallet API sendTransaction (Arc uses a minimal Privy EIP-1193 adapter so Circle kit.swap only needs eth_sendTransaction). Policy caps and optional Tenderly simulation sit in front of broadcast.

Partner stacks we leaned on hard:
• Privy — core identity, custody, funding, and live settlement (not just login).
• The Graph — Subgraph MCP for live Chain Search; Substreams authoring from natural language into strategy edges (token_flow_alert).
• Circle Arc + Swap Kit — USDC-native gas and USDC↔EURC FX where 0x has no route.
• OpenRouter / dsh — agent turns with crypto-native tools (balances, quotes, social, intel) and host-provisioned MCP builtins so operators never paste API keys for the core loop.

Notable glue: Cordis plugins publish flat JSON artifacts to the agent workspace; the host syncs them into activity/SSE for desk cards. Substreams pipelines use a studio-style deterministic stream head so Arm loops stay reliable without a separate sink subscription on every laptop. Funding destinations resolve to USDC on Privy settle rails (Base/ETH/Arb/OP) with an explicit fallback when the agent’s home chain isn’t fundable yet.
auto_summary: A monorepo for creating DeFi agents that research markets, draft strategies, simulate trades, and execute live transactions through hosted services.
